purpose: Teach: 人様/見合っ/ヶ国/すぐさま/助長/覆っ/ほかなら/乗せる

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが人様に迷惑を掛けない方だった
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father never caused trouble for anyone.
lines.style: Soft, reflective opening. Voice drifts into memory. Measured pace, almost conversational with himself. Gentle certainty — not questioning, remembering aloud.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、孫と目を見合って嬉しそうにされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and your father, he'd look our grandchildren right in the eye and light up, wouldn't he?
lines.style: Warm, conversational. Lean into the shared memory with gentle affection. Soft rise on the question — drawing him into agreement, not challenging. Voice carries the ease of long knowing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが二十ヶ国近く回られた
lines.en: Gran, in those years, your father traveled to nearly twenty countries.
lines.style: Still reflective, but with a thread of quiet pride. Slight lift on the number — genuine appreciation for the scope. Voice stays grounded, not boasting. Almost marveling at the fact.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、危急時にはすぐさま動かれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and when there was a crisis, he'd act without hesitation, wouldn't he?
lines.style: Affirming, with quiet respect woven in. Quick, assured delivery on the action itself. The question tag is tender, drawing him further into shared understanding. No doubt in her voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが悪行を助長しない厳格な方だった
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father was a strict man who never encouraged wrongdoing.
lines.style: Respectful admiration in the tone. Slight weight on 'strict' — not harsh, but principled. Voice steady and clear. The sentence carries weight without strain.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、晩年は冬は布団で覆って暖かくしてらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and in his later years, he'd make sure to wrap himself warm in blankets through the winter, wouldn't he?
lines.style: Shift to tender domesticity. The image of care is almost intimate. Voice softens on the practical detail. Question rises gently — an invitation to see the man in the small gesture.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんはほかならぬ家族の柱だった
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father was the true pillar of our family.
lines.style: Deep stillness in this one. Voice settles into weight and significance. Slow, deliberate. The word 'pillar' lands with quiet importance. This is the sum of what he's saying.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、孫を膝に乗せるのがお好きだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and he loved nothing more than holding the grandchildren on his knee, didn't he?
lines.style: Voice pools with warmth and closeness. Almost whispered affection. The image is vivid and small — a hand, a lap, a child's weight. Gentle exhale on the ending, like settling into the memory itself.
